'''Rob Jefferys''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Minnesota State Championship]] on 6 May 2000 with [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Bothawui speeder ops]], according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d725">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-11-mirkwood-richfield-mn-5-6-00-stated725/ mirkwood-richfield-mn-5-6-00-state], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 11 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-11-mirkwood-richfield-mn-5-6-00-stated725/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
